definitions.gloss: Hiroshima (city and prefecture in western Japan)
definitions.explanation: A major city and prefecture in the Chugoku region. Known worldwide for the August 6, 1945 atomic bombing and its postwar peace memorial sites, as well as for local specialties like oysters and okonomiyaki.

examples.japanese: {広島|ひろしま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
⟦{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}→修学旅行：05590_shuugakuryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{広島|ひろしま}{平和記念公園|へいわきねんこうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: We visited the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park on our school trip.

examples.japanese: {広島|ひろしま}{風|ふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていて→入る：00494_hairu⟧{食|た}べ{応|ごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki contains noodles and is filling.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide) + ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧ (island). Refers either to the city or the prefecture; context usually clarifies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広島|ひろしま}{県|けん}: Hiroshima Prefecture
- {広島|ひろしま}{市|し}: Hiroshima City
- {広島|ひろしま}⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧: the Hiroshima atomic bomb
- {広島|ひろしま}{風|ふう}⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧: Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki
- {広島|ひろしま}カープ: Hiroshima Carp (baseball team)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Internationally known for the August 6, 1945 atomic bombing; the ⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧⟦ドーム→ドーム：24058_doomu⟧ (Atomic Bomb Dome) is a UNESCO World Heritage site. Local specialties include oysters (⟦{牡蠣|かき}→牡蠣：10786_kaki⟧), Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki (layered with noodles, unlike the Osaka mixed style), and もみじ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧ (maple-leaf-shaped sweets from nearby Miyajima).
